checks.name: planter_version
checks.description: Errors when the planter running the checks is older than the minimum version these checks need (planter_too_old).

checks.name: gn_secondary_tree
checks.description: Rejects Bazel files/deps in //build/secondary/ and MODULE.bazel repositories over current-layout third_party code (bazel_build_in_gn_secondary_tree, bazel_dep_on_gn_secondary_tree, repository_for_current_layout_third_party).

checks.name: migration_sanity
checks.description: Checks sentinel sync and @bazel2gn:skip rules (skipped_convertible_target, unjustified_test_skip, redundant_bazel2gn_skip, unnecessary_manual_tag).

checks.name: gn_dep_parity
checks.description: Checks GN dep labels, link deps, and public_deps configs (dep_label_removed, dep_label_substituted, dep_link_settings_dropped).

checks.name: gn_attr_parity
checks.description: Checks GN-only attrs, output names, and local #include headers (gn_only_attr_dropped, undeclared_cc_local_header).

checks.name: gn_target_type_parity
checks.description: Checks GN templates: alwayslink, test vs executable, LTO config (source_set_without_alwayslink, test_became_executable, cc_test_executable_lost_lto_config, host_test_lost; INFO test_became_cc_test_executable, executable_became_cc_test_executable).

checks.name: visibility_audit
checks.description: Audits BUILD.bazel visibility via find_rdeps, restricted rust_crates allowlists, and cross-package dep access (overbroad_public_visibility, visibility_narrowed, visibility_widened_beyond_gn, missing_rust_crates_visibility, inaccessible_cross_package_dep).

checks.name: build_only_scope
checks.description: Blocks non-build source edits except allowed test .cml or README labels (non_build_file_modified).

checks.name: lint_config_parity
checks.description: Flags lint-silencing source edits and custom lint_config missing defaults (lint_driven_source_edit).

checks.name: shared_config_reuse
checks.description: Flags lint_config alias wrappers, copied lint dicts, and duplicated declare_args (alias_obscures_config, duplicated_default_lints, inline_gn_declare_args).

checks.name: bazel_minimality
checks.description: Audits Starlark wrapper rules, symbolic macro attrs, IDK atom allowlists, default attrs, host constraints, and buildifier (unwrapped_external_language_rule, unsupported_fx_component_attribute, missing_idk_atom_allowlist, buildifier_lint).

checks.name: cq_reachability
checks.description: Verifies tests reach group("tests"), umbrella ffx_plugin test sections/comments, and aggregation test_suite(), and HEAD merges cleanly onto origin/main and any composite dependency stack ref (unexported_bazel_test, stale_plugin_tests_aggregation_comment, ungrouped_migrated_plugin_tests, unrebased_composite_stack, prerequisite_bazel_targets_overwritten).

checks.name: confidentiality_check
checks.description: Blocks internal vendor paths, domains, emails, handles, and names (confidentiality_violation).

checks.name: gn_format
checks.description: Checks the GN prebuilt matches the pinned revision and runs `gn format --dry-run` on added or modified GN files (stale_gn_prebuilt, gn_format, gn_syntax_error).

checks.name: bazel_shac_lint
checks.description: Runs scripts/shac/bazel_lint rules on modified Starlark files (category is the shac rule name).

checks.name: commit_message_format
checks.description: Validates commit subject/body format, line lengths, footers, test-parity footers (Renamed-Tests:, Skipped-Dual-Tests:, forbidden Deleted-Tests:/Build-Only:), and NO_IFTTT lines (commit_subject_format, commit_subject_overstates_migration, commit_subject_broad_tag, missing_bazel_migration_target_footer, agent_added_no_ifttt).

checks.name: test_data_attribute
checks.description: Flags test-only fixtures in `data` (test_only_data_in_data), host test data in `data` of host_rustc_test (host_test_data_in_data), attribute-level `@bazel2gn:skip` on `test_data` of unskipped host tests (skipped_test_data_attr_on_host_test), runtime test fixtures in `compile_data` (runtime_test_data_in_compile_data), unreferenced `test_data` targets (unused_test_data), undocumented omitted GN `host_test_data` entries (undocumented_omitted_host_test_data), GN `$root_build_dir` host_test_data/copy outputs colliding across variant toolchains (host_test_data_root_build_dir_outputs, unguarded_root_build_dir_outputs), runtime `.exists()` fallback probing (runtime_test_data_path_probing), and unskipped GN host tests missing staged test data (dual_build_test_data_fallback_dropped).

checks.name: test_suite_layout
checks.description: Enforces two-tier Bazel test_suite() and GN bazel_test_suite() layout, explicit tests = [...] lists, and human review when expanding an existing empty test_suite() (per_package_bazel_test_suite, bazel_test_suite_only_build_gn, nested_test_suite, implicit_test_suite, expanded_empty_test_suite).

checks.name: build_verification
checks.description: Runs `fx build`, GN rdeps, `fx lint`, `fx bazel build`, and host tests (build_failure_<step>, preexisting_failure_<step>).

checks.name: tests_json_parity
checks.description: Verifies <build dir>/tests.json parity across GN-to-Bazel migrations via verify_tests_json_parity.py across product roots and off-CQ developer leaf groups, enforcing Case 1/Case 2/Case 3 variant transitions, attribute parity, and 1:1 Renamed-Tests: bijections (test_dropped_from_tests_json).

checks.name: speculative_unit_test
checks.description: Rejects empty unit tests, unrequested host test wrappers, and no-op with_unit_tests TODOs (speculative_empty_unit_test, redundant_empty_unit_test_todo).

checks.name: cc_header_deps_and_annotations
checks.description: Requires comments on new @bazel2gn directives, disable_build_flags TODOs on rustc_* configs -= directives, LINT.IfChange guards on inlined file lists, preserved multi-line BUILD.gn explanatory comments on migrated attributes/targets, public header deps in `deps`, and upstream in-tree C/C++ headers declared in `hdrs` (undocumented_bazel2gn_directive, rustc_configs_remove_missing_todo, inlined_file_list_missing_ifttt, dropped_gn_comment_block, undeclared_upstream_cc_header, redundant_builtin_label_directive).

checks.name: package_boundary_labels
checks.description: Flags ancestor BUILD.bazel files naming files under a newly added Bazel package by relative path (crossed_package_boundary).

checks.name: owners_allowlist_scope
checks.description: Verifies mirrored Starlark allowlist dict entries stay in OWNERS-gated subdirectories matching their GN group definitions (owners_scoped_allowlist_misplaced).

checks.name: macro_api_parity
checks.description: Audits changed symbolic macros and GN templates for API drift (macro_redeclares_inherited_attr, macro_list_attr_none_compare, gn_template_crate_name_not_forwarded).
